detail: DECLARED (exploratory, NOT executed through the ledger; the required gates run later on the final bytes). Reproduced on the UNMODIFIED worktree bytes at 6785e0c7 (perawatan case sha 1815a22a4c0a): the WHOLE tests/isolation/isolation.test.ts, no -t filter, 'Tests 1 failed | 203 passed | 1 skipped (205)', the same error as CI 44997538283: 'as B, K7 is {kind: unavailable, reason: incomplete}, not <price - cost>'. Log kept: /data/tmp/t116ci-evidence/repro-full.run1-unmodified.log. Why my own T-116 evidence missed it: every isolation run I did, including the ledger's executed 'isolation-laporan' gate, used -t '(coverage gate|/laporan/)', which removes every OTHER case, so B never held the fixtures other cases leave behind; CI runs the whole file. Cause, from a scratch-only probe (the worktree has no probe; probe.log): at B's branch CAB01, K7's inputs are two dispense movements: this case's own (value -5953570, uncosted 0, unit 5953570) and one UNCOSTED (value 0, uncosted_qty -1, unit_cost null). The reader (0126, K7) flags every dispense/consume movement with uncosted_qty <> 0 as 'uncosted' and live.ts turns that into incomplete (A-13, 'biaya belum lengkap'): by design, never zero cost. Static search says only apotek.cases.ts (4th in the order, before the laporan cases) hands over stock of B, from stock received through receiveStock WITHOUT a unit cost; this is inferred, and is confirmed in the next scratch run by naming the item. No KPI, reader, grant or other case file is involved or will be changed.

detail: DECLARED (scratch-only probe, probe.run2-named.log; NOT ledger-executed). Confirms the inference of 'ci-failure-reproduced-and-diagnosed'. A second full-order scratch run named every K7-relevant movement of tenant B (it has ONE branch, CAB01): (1) seq 5, dispense, qty -1, value 0, uncosted_qty -1, unit_cost null, item 'Serum Rahasia', patient 'Pasien Rahasia Apotek <B>', dispensing state handed, not via an invoice: this is apotek.cases.ts (stock received through receiveStock WITHOUT a unit cost, then handed over by B's own pharmacist in the positive control of the apotek action case, whose attempts must all succeed as B); (2) seq 9, dispense, qty -1, value -8600157, uncosted 0, unit_cost 8600157, item 'Produk Rahasia Perawatan', via invoice: this case's own sale. The costing trigger (0080) values a dispense with no costed quantity on hand as value 0 / uncosted_qty = -qty; the K7 reader (0126) adds one 'uncosted' fact per such movement and live.ts maps uncosted > 0 to 'incomplete' (A-13: never a zero cost). So B's K7 at CAB01 is incomplete for the whole rest of the run once apotek ran (apotek is 4th of 60 in the case order, laporan-perawatan 29th); with the -t selector apotek never ran, which is why every isolation run of mine, the executed 'isolation-laporan' gate included, was green. Only apotek.cases.ts and laporan-perawatan.cases.ts hand over stock. Fix direction (the ONLY file allowed): seed this case's sale at a branch of B that no other case touches (precedent: pembelian.cases.ts adds a second branch to B), read B's K7 for that branch, and keep both assertions strict. No KPI, reader, grant, apotek case or other file changes.

Fixed case sha 1469948d1af4. ROUND 2 (ci-mut.round2.*): baseline isolation 204 passed, unit 53 passed. KILLED 5 of 6: C2 (CASE: the sale never paid) killed in the isolation run, BUT by the writer refusing at seeding (ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT), a hard failure that is NOT proof the K7 assertion is sharp; C3 (CASE: the sale back at B's first branch = the CI bug) killed by the case's own message 'as B, K7 at its own branch is incomplete'; K1 (CODE: the page core answers a foreign branch with ok instead of not-found) killed in 7 isolation cases, listed by the keep run (ci-mut-k1.keep, executed): marketing, operasional, pasien, penjualan, perawatan, staf, stok; K3 (CODE: the K7 total read as 0) killed in isolation by the exact positive control ('K7 is money 0, not <price - cost>') and by the unit selector; K4 (CODE: the K7 total plus one rupiah) killed in isolation by the exact positive control ('K7 is money N, not N-1') and by the unit selector: this is the sharpness probe, executed. SURVIVOR, stated plainly: K2 (CODE: the K7 mapping no longer treats uncosted as incomplete) SURVIVES the isolation selector, because this case reads only B's own branch LPR2 and never B's first branch CAB01 where the uncosted dispense lives; it is KILLED by the unit selector (the test 'K5 with pre-cutover residue and K7 with an uncosted movement are incomplete'). So 'uncosted -> incomplete' is enforced by reports.test.ts, not by this case, and that is by design (the case proves isolation, not costing). NOT RERUN, kept as history only (ci-mut.round1.*): ROUND 1 tried four more CASE-file mutants and learned most of them cannot be killed by editing the case: C1 (the positive control accepts any money figure) SURVIVED and C4/C5 (a dropped 404 condition), C6 (the new branch not registered as a victim secret) SURVIVED, because with correct code there is no leak, so A's body and the 404s are identical with or without the weakening; those four are NOT claimed as killed. In particular: the exactness of the positive control is proved by K4 (a code mutant), not by C1, and that C1 survives means the harness marker (the body must contain the digits of price - cost) already enforces the same figure, so the explicit throw is a second guard that gives a clear message.
